name: Workspace save last url visited in params
description:
Here's a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. The task was to persist the last URL visited inside an app iframe so it can be restored when the AppWindow is re-created.
2. Analysis revealed the persistence path already existed in `AppWindow` and `store/ui.js`, but was dead code because `Iframe.vue` never emitted `navigated`.
3. The proposed fix adds navigation tracking to `Iframe.vue` via emitting `navigated` on load plus a 1s poll (same-origin only) to catch SPA route changes.
4. `AppWindow.vue` was updated to track a separate `lastUrl` (not the `src`-bound `currentUrl`) to prevent full iframe reloads on each navigation.
5. The end-to-end flow now persists the URL through `updateAppParams` → dockview layout → localStorage, restoring the last page on next open.

<template>
  <iframe ref="iframe" :src="url" class="bg-base-300" 
    @load="onIframeLoaded"
    title="coder" allow="camera *;microphone *;clipboard-read; clipboard-write;">
  </iframe>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  props: ['url', 'nocheck'],
  emits: ['loaded', 'navigated'],
  data() {
    return {
      trackedUrl: null,
      urlCheckInterval: null
    }
  },
  beforeUnmount() {
    this.stopUrlTracking()
  },
  methods: {
    onIframeLoaded() {
      const { iframe } = this.$refs
      if (!iframe?.contentWindow) {
        return setTimeout(() => this.onIframeLoaded, 2000)
      }
      // Track in-app (SPA) navigations that don't fire a `load` event
      this.startUrlTracking()
      if (this.nocheck) {
        return this.$emit('loaded', iframe)
      }
      this.$emit('loaded', iframe)
    },
    // Emit `navigated` whenever the iframe url changes (same-origin only)
    trackNavigation() {
      try {
        const contentWindow = this.$refs.iframe?.contentWindow
        const url = contentWindow?.location?.href
        if (!url || url === 'about:blank') return
        if (url === this.trackedUrl) return
        this.trackedUrl = url
        this.$emit('navigated', url, contentWindow?.document?.title)
      } catch (e) {
        // Cross-origin access blocked, stop polling
        this.stopUrlTracking()
      }
    },
    startUrlTracking() {
      this.trackNavigation()
      if (!this.urlCheckInterval) {
        this.urlCheckInterval = setInterval(() => this.trackNavigation(), 1000)
      }
    },
    stopUrlTracking() {
      if (this.urlCheckInterval) {
        clearInterval(this.urlCheckInterval)
        this.urlCheckInterval = null
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>
